glasses_omar: Highly variable. Missed nightstand_b1 (07:00, 22:55) and coffee_table_l1 (10:08, 21:35, 09:28). Do not assume it stays in the bathroom or bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1, nightstand_b1, and desk_b1.

charger_omar: Missed coffee_table_l1 (10:22, 11:21) after assuming bed_b1 or desk_b1. It is not always in the bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1, entry_floor_e1, and entry_hook_e1.

book_omar: Missed coffee_table_l1 (13:03, 08:44, 11:32) after assuming couch_l1 or bed_b1. It is not always on the couch or bed. Check coffee_table_l1 and bed_b1.

razor_omar: Missed sink_ba_ba1 (07:00) after assuming bathroom_shelf_ba1. Do not assume it is on the shelf. Check sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1.

General: Coffee_table_l1 is the most frequent location for Omar’s items (glasses, mug, water bottle, charger, book). Do not assume items are in the kitchen, bedroom, or on the desk. Always check coffee_table_l1 first for Omar’s personal items. Avoid assuming fixed locations for mugs, water bottles, or glasses.
